purpose: Live Power Stack thematic radar; dynamic ranking by freshness/materiality and current market significance. Theme rank changes research priority, not company fundamental scores.

environment.label: 5% capital scarcity + resilient selective AI demand + easing crude scarcity
environment.summary: High nominal yields remain the dominant cross-asset constraint, but Sep 21 Asian technology strength confirms AI demand has not broadly broken. Saudi export recovery is reducing crude scarcity premium. Power/electrical shortages, LNG market access and critical-mineral security remain the strongest physical themes.

whatIsNewNow: Saudi export recovery/rerouting pushed Brent toward $103 and WTI near $100, weakening the immediate crude-scarcity impulse.
Asian technology/AI shares strengthened Sep 21 despite hawkish global rates, reinforcing funded/selective AI rather than blanket capex collapse.
US-China talks explicitly include AI, trade and critical-mineral flows ahead of the leaders' summit.
China kept 1Y/5Y LPRs at 3.00%/3.50% for a 16th month, confirming constrained broad easing.
RoboTechnik launches its Hong Kong secondary listing Sep 21; pricing remains the key valuation test.
Official August ISM shortages remain concentrated in electrical/electronic components, memory, copper, GPUs, wire/cable and tungsten.
whatMattersMostToMarketsNow: Refined products/shipping versus easing crude scarcity

themes.name: Capital Scarcity / Duration + Funded-vs-Unfunded
themes.whyNow: US 10Y closed about 5.01% Sep 18 and 2Y about 4.76%; hawkish Fed expectations keep financing and valuation hurdles elevated.
themes.marketTransmission: project finance, equity multiples, credit, housing, breadth, capex hurdle rates
themes.confirmation: long yields remain near/above 5% while weak projects require concessions
themes.invalidation: durable yield decline with improving breadth/credit and no renewed inflation
themes.nextTest: Treasury/credit trading and inflation-sensitive energy data
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Prefer contracted/funded cash conversion; avoid duration-heavy averaging down.

themes.name: AI Infrastructure Demand + Financing Dispersion
themes.whyNow: Sep 21 Asian tech strength shows AI demand remains market-significant despite high rates; financing remains discriminating rather than closed.
themes.marketTransmission: chips, data-centre finance, supplier backlog, credit spreads, capex multiples
themes.confirmation: funded orders and institutional finance persist while weaker structures trade at discounts
themes.invalidation: broad cancellation of funded hyperscaler projects and supplier backlog deterioration
themes.nextTest: project debt pricing, deposits/backlog and capex guidance
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Favor funded physical suppliers; no blanket AI beta.

themes.name: Power / Grid / Electrical Bottlenecks
themes.whyNow: Official ISM still reports shortages in electrical/electronic components, memory, copper, GPUs, wire/cable and tungsten, validating the physical bottleneck chain.
themes.marketTransmission: generation, backup power, transformers, switchgear, cables, metals, utility capex
themes.confirmation: signed orders, funded projects, energised MW, persistent shortages and FCF conversion
themes.invalidation: broad cancellations/backlog deterioration and shortage normalization
themes.nextTest: supplier orders, utility capex and YTL funded project awards
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: YTLPOWR hold; ETN/PWR quality but entry discipline; GNRC/PRYMY research.

themes.name: Middle East Refined Products + Shipping
themes.whyNow: Saudi export recovery and rerouting are reducing immediate crude scarcity, but product/logistics risks remain inflation-relevant.
themes.marketTransmission: diesel, freight, tanker rates, inflation, farm/consumer margins
themes.confirmation: product cracks/inventories and war-risk freight remain stressed despite crude easing
themes.invalidation: route normalization plus product inventory rebuild
themes.nextTest: EIA products, Saudi route normalization and shipping rates
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Hold existing energy; do not chase war premium.

themes.name: US LNG Rerouting + China Market Access
themes.whyNow: China tariff discussions remain live and China Gas signed a 20-year US LNG deal; market-access upside must be separated from weak aggregate Chinese LNG demand.
themes.marketTransmission: US gas demand, LNG contracting, Asian/European gas prices, trade flows
themes.confirmation: tariff cut, resumed Chinese contracting and strong liquefaction utilization
themes.invalidation: trade talks fail and weak China demand overwhelms contracting
themes.nextTest: leaders' summit package and new SPA/cargo evidence
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: LNG remains top entry-asymmetry research candidate.

themes.name: Critical Minerals / Copper / Tungsten Security
themes.whyNow: Critical-mineral flows are explicitly in current US-China talks while ISM reports copper and tungsten products in short supply.
themes.marketTransmission: AI hardware, grid capex, cables, defence, industrial policy, mining margins
themes.confirmation: policy agreements plus persistent physical premiums/shortages and funded orders
themes.invalidation: trade normalization plus inventory rebuild and weakening end-demand
themes.nextTest: US-China summit language, FCX stabilization and physical inventories/premiums
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: FCX preferred-zone research; avoid speculative miners without cash flow.

themes.name: AI Security / Independent Model Evaluation
themes.whyNow: Anthropic/Accenture committed at least $2B over five years to independent frontier-model evaluation; AI-assisted cyber risk is increasingly an operating-budget issue.
themes.marketTransmission: cyber budgets, AI governance, consulting/evaluation spend, regulation
themes.confirmation: recurring evaluation/security contracts and ARR/bookings growth
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Selective pullbacks only; ACN differentiated research.

themes.name: Uranium / Nuclear Fuel + Buildout
themes.whyNow: Fuel-cycle localization and long-duration power remain strategic, but no fresher Sep 21 catalyst outranks critical minerals or LNG.
themes.marketTransmission: uranium contracting, enrichment, reactor supply chain, long-duration power
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: CCJ attractive research; valuation discipline remains essential.

themes.name: Agriculture / Fertilizer / Food Affordability
themes.whyNow: US-China talks include potential agricultural purchases, but crop/input economics remain the main gate for farm-input demand.
themes.marketTransmission: food inflation, farm margins, input volumes, machinery capex, trade flows
themes.confirmation: crop/input ratios improve for high-quality inputs and export demand strengthens
themes.invalidation: farm margins deteriorate enough to cut core inputs
themes.nextTest: trade package, crop conditions, fertilizer pricing and export flows
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: CTVA/BG first; CF/NTR selective; VMI later; AGCO second-stage only.

themes.name: Robotics / Automation Commercialization
themes.whyNow: RoboTechnik launches its HK listing while China embodied-AI development remains active; commercial proof and valuation are still the filters.
themes.marketTransmission: factory automation, machine vision, motion control, optical interconnect equipment
themes.confirmation: recurring external revenue and measurable productivity ROI
themes.nextTest: RoboTechnik Sep 24 pricing and external deployments
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Fixed/warehouse first; wait for HK pricing.

themes.name: Gold / Silver / Miners
themes.whyNow: Gold near $4,370 remains resilient but high nominal yields and hawkish policy cap tactical upside.
themes.marketTransmission: real yields, dollar, reserve diversification, geopolitical hedging
themes.invalidation: real yields/dollar surge with weakening physical/ETF demand
themes.nextTest: real yields, dollar and central-bank/ETF flows

themes.name: ESS Demand vs Battery Manufacturing Overcapacity
themes.whyNow: Deployment demand remains real, but no fresh evidence displaces persistent manufacturing overcapacity and weak generic miner economics.
themes.marketTransmission: storage integrators, cells, lithium pricing, utility capex
themes.confirmation: deployment growth with rationalized manufacturing capacity
themes.invalidation: new capacity resumes faster than demand
themes.watchlistHoldingAction: Favor storage cash conversion; generic lithium remains background/dormant.
